physics_goals.quote: searches with 11 kg of enriched 76 Ge for double beta decay in the GRAN Sasso underground laboratory
physics_goals.value: Search for neutrinoless double beta decay of 76Ge with enriched germanium detectors, which tests lepton-number conservation and probes the effective Majorana neutrino mass

summary.plain: A germanium experiment in the Gran Sasso tunnel that looked for neutrinoless double beta decay from 1990 to 2003. Five detectors made of germanium enriched in 76Ge served as source and detector at once. It set one of the strongest limits of its day on the Majorana neutrino mass; part of the team later claimed a signal.
summary.technical: 76Ge neutrinoless double-beta decay search: five HPGe detectors of 86 % enriched 76Ge (19.2 kg of enriched material, 10.96 kg active mass), shielded in lead and borated polyethylene at LNGS; pulse-shape analysis separated single-site from multiple-site events. Data August 1990 - May 2003, 71.7 kg y. The 1999 limit with 24 kg y of pulse-shape data was T1/2 > 5.7e25 yr (90 % C.L.).
